candidate_units.title: Prove production builds exclude dev, fixture and concept surfaces
candidate_units.scope: Extend PR #567 (no product change beyond #567). Add e2e/production-surface.config.ts: a dedicated webServer that runs `vite build` with default production env, then `vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4176 --strictPort`, with VITE_SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 and every non-loopback request aborted. Add e2e/production-surface.browser.ts; the *.browser.ts suffix keeps it out of default ./e2e discovery. It visits /debug/concepts, /debug/state-gallery, /dev-login, /engineering, /dev/engineering and asserts the NotFound page with no gallery or workbench heading. It visits /parts/fx-job-quoted-a?fixture=client-quoted&debug=1 and asserts no [data-fixture-panel], no 'Fixture controls' region and no 'Synthetic quote comparison' text. It asserts no [data-agentation-toolbar] on any visited route. Add scripts/verify-production-bundle-exclusions.mjs plus a node test that scan dist/assets for chunks or markers of ConceptsGallery, StateGallery, DevLogin, AnnotationToolbar, agentation and EngineeringWorkbench, failing closed on a missing dist. Add an `e2e:production-surface` package.json script, a step in the CI browser-test job, and an update to scripts/playwright-lane-config.test.mjs. Do not assert on fixture-data bytes or `?debug=1` diagnostics until Blaine decides those open questions.

The same spec run against a production build of origin/main 8d8d243 fails on /debug/concepts (gallery renders), and that failure output is pasted in the PR.
